leaves.name: Identity
leaves.loop: Enter name, pronouns and acting title; preview; edit; confirm
leaves.effects: Names and wording propagate into dialogue labels, contracts, credits and history
leaves.recovery: Invalid or unsupported input stays editable without clearing other entries

leaves.name: Background And Languages
leaves.loop: Select multiple ethnicities; select primary and additional languages with proficiency; review custom entries
leaves.effects: Chosen language proficiency informs appropriate communication and casting requirements; heritage remains identity, never an automatic ability bonus
leaves.recovery: Duplicates and unsupported entries get a clear correction path; suggestions never silently select fluency

leaves.name: Starting Circumstances
leaves.loop: Choose birthplace, starting place, birthday and valid 2026 date/time; preview local context
leaves.effects: Initial timezone, calendar, weather and birthdays use the selected place and date
leaves.recovery: Invalid dates and unavailable location data prevent confirmation with retry or editing

leaves.name: Four Professions
leaves.loop: Make screenwriting, producing, directing and acting available immediately; choose participation per project
leaves.effects: Actual work creates credits; simultaneous roles create scheduling and responsibility constraints
leaves.recovery: Leaving a role requires a replacement or a clear blocked dependency, not lost authorship

leaves.name: Review And Draft
leaves.loop: Save creation draft; inspect each field; edit from Review; return; start
leaves.effects: One authoritative creation record becomes the save; draft survives interruption
leaves.recovery: Validation preserves input; recovery never opens the wrong step or creates duplicate lives

leaves.name: Active Clock
leaves.loop: Run at one real second per game second during the defined active session; save time; close and reopen
leaves.effects: Every engine reads one authoritative instant and derives local time
leaves.recovery: No offline catch-up; no double counting from duplicate tabs; define hidden-tab and device-suspension behavior explicitly

leaves.name: Advance And Sleep
leaves.loop: Choose duration or destination; preview intervening commitments; process events in order; stop at required decisions
leaves.effects: Deadlines, work, weather, fatigue if explicitly in scope, and calendar updates share elapsed time
leaves.recovery: Rollback failed event batches; resume safely without repeating payments or losing events; no manual play/pause control

leaves.name: Geography And Travel
leaves.loop: Find country or territory, region and city; inspect production relevance; arrange necessary travel
leaves.effects: Location affects timezone, weather, daylight, holidays and arrival feasibility
leaves.recovery: Unavailable geography is identified; impossible arrival blocks attendance with reschedule options; no unrelated tourism or housing system

leaves.name: Weather And Daylight
leaves.loop: Inspect forecast; schedule work; encounter conditions; move indoors, protect work or postpone
leaves.effects: Outdoor work, continuity, available daylight and production costs reflect conditions
leaves.recovery: Forecast uncertainty is visible; no identical weather everywhere; postponed work retains reservations and history correctly

leaves.name: Calendar And Commitments
leaves.loop: Create or receive event; inspect; accept; get reminder; attend, decline, cancel or reschedule
leaves.effects: Birthdays, meetings, shoots, recordings, screenings and deadlines link to their actual activity
leaves.recovery: Conflicts name the affected commitments; meaningful event-specific buttons replace generic Go or Stand There

leaves.name: Format And Medium
leaves.loop: Choose format, story approach, medium and technique as separate dimensions; inspect compatible combinations
leaves.effects: Feature, short, series, special, fiction, documentary, animation, live action and hybrid route into appropriate production
leaves.recovery: Unsupported combinations explain the constraint; do not silently convert the project

leaves.name: Creative Identity
leaves.loop: Set title, multiple genres, tone, setting, audience and languages
leaves.effects: Genre conventions create relevant questions and explicit requirements; identity follows all project documents
leaves.recovery: No genre selection alone grants prestige or quality; preserve custom creative text

leaves.name: Scope
leaves.loop: Set runtime, cast scale, locations and technical ambition; preview resource drivers
leaves.effects: Scenes and assets determine estimates, staffing and capacity
leaves.recovery: Overambitious scope remains editable; give concrete cost-reduction options

leaves.name: Project Workspace
leaves.loop: Create concept; save; reopen; compare current state; archive or cancel deliberately
leaves.effects: Stable project ID connects documents, deals, participants, schedules and history
leaves.recovery: Cancellation settles commitments rather than deleting them; duplicate titles remain distinguishable

leaves.name: Compatibility Review
leaves.loop: Explain applicable stages and conditional requirements before development
leaves.effects: A shared project model supports distinct medium pipelines
leaves.recovery: Every unsupported branch has an explicit status; never show an inert control as implemented

leaves.name: Concept And Intent
leaves.loop: Write premise, logline, question, stakes, themes and intended experience; revise
leaves.effects: Documents and creative reference use exact player text
leaves.recovery: Completeness can be checked; the engine must not pretend it understands prose quality

leaves.name: Structure And Threads
leaves.loop: Create acts or sequences; establish turns; connect threads to scenes and characters; resolve or deliberately leave open
leaves.effects: Structure guides revision and editing dependencies
leaves.recovery: Broken links identify exact scenes; intentional unresolved threads remain valid choices

leaves.name: Setups And Payoffs
leaves.loop: Declare setup, planting scene and payoff scene; inspect connection; change or remove
leaves.effects: Cutting or rewriting linked scenes creates specific editorial warnings
leaves.recovery: Restore a scene, relocate setup/payoff or explicitly revise the dependency

leaves.name: Research And References
leaves.loop: Record factual questions and production references; attach notes; mark reviewed or uncertain
leaves.effects: Research informs explicit setting and production choices; provenance remains in developer records
leaves.recovery: Unverified claims remain unverified; blocked sources lead to alternate public primary sources, never invented verification

leaves.name: Documents And Submissions
leaves.loop: Build outline, treatment, pitch and statement; review required fields; explicitly submit snapshot
leaves.effects: Backers and institutions receive the correct version with timestamp and requirements
leaves.recovery: Later edits do not rewrite previously sent documents; missing material names exact fields

leaves.name: Character Definition
leaves.loop: Create name, aliases, pronouns, age range, description and background; edit
leaves.effects: Stable character identity links scenes, casts, assets, episode appearances and credits
leaves.recovery: Renaming updates displays without breaking IDs or erasing history

leaves.name: Size And Function
leaves.loop: Choose role size independently from narrative functions; allow multiple functions; choose award placement where applicable
leaves.effects: Billing, participation and category entries remain separate from protagonist or antagonist status
leaves.recovery: Supporting antagonist stays supporting unless placement changes; organizer-specific restrictions override generic defaults

leaves.name: Type And Performance
leaves.loop: Choose human, animal, creature or other supported type; select on-camera, voice, capture, puppetry or combined methods
leaves.effects: Costume, makeup, creature assets, performers, stunts and recording work derive from explicit needs
leaves.recovery: Unsupported methods explain why; one method must not falsely fulfill another

leaves.name: Arcs And Relationships
leaves.loop: Define objectives, obstacles and changes; establish directed relationships; connect beats to scenes
leaves.effects: Scene continuity and series development track declared changes
leaves.recovery: Deleting a character previews dependent relationships and scenes; remap or deliberately remove

leaves.name: Appearance Breakdown
leaves.loop: Assign scenes and episodes; review screen participation and requirements
leaves.effects: Casting days, regular/guest commitments, costume continuity and credits reflect actual work
leaves.recovery: A character with no production participation must not generate unexplained fees or credits

leaves.name: Scene Setup
leaves.loop: Choose episode, sequence, location, interior/exterior, day/night, participants and duration
leaves.effects: Breakdown, schedules, cast bookings, runtime and daylight requirements
leaves.recovery: Impossible or missing combinations are actionable validation messages

leaves.name: Action And Dialogue
leaves.loop: Write action and dialogue; assign speakers and languages; save
leaves.effects: Player text persists into screenplay and creative reference; explicit language choices drive recording/localization needs
leaves.recovery: Text length is not a quality score; unsupported speaker references require repair

leaves.name: Production Breakdown
leaves.loop: Declare props, crowds, animals, stunts, intimacy, music, vehicles and effects; review linked tasks
leaves.effects: Required resources, specialist crew, preparation, costs and dependencies
leaves.recovery: Remove a requirement only with a preview of cancelled bookings or stranded assets

leaves.name: Scene Organization
leaves.loop: Insert, reorder, duplicate, split, combine, cut and restore
leaves.effects: Order and IDs preserve links across threads, assets and editing
leaves.recovery: Copies receive new IDs; split/combine operations explicitly remap links rather than guessing

leaves.name: Draft Approval And Revision
leaves.loop: Save version; compare; review notes; approve; revise approved material with impact preview
leaves.effects: Unchanged filmed work survives; changed work creates precise reshoot, asset or schedule consequences
leaves.recovery: Confirm costly revisions; preserve old versions and explain incompatible footage; no reward for repeatedly clicking revise

leaves.name: Series Bible
leaves.loop: Define series premise, format, continuing world, characters and continuity rules
leaves.effects: Shared reference governs season and episode planning
leaves.recovery: Changing shared facts previews affected episodes instead of silently rewriting history

leaves.name: Season And Episode Planning
leaves.loop: Create season arc; order episodes; set durations; allocate stories, scenes and locations
leaves.effects: Season budget aggregates episode work without treating one episode as the whole season
leaves.recovery: Missing episodes or unresolved delivery obligations remain visible

leaves.name: Regulars Guests And Credits
leaves.loop: Choose recurring participation; book actual episode work; assign episode-specific crew
leaves.effects: Contracts, availability, fees and credits reflect appearances and contributed work
leaves.recovery: Guest spanning episodes prompts contract review; regular status does not create footage or earned credit automatically

leaves.name: Showrunning And Production
leaves.loop: Assign creative oversight; writing and directing responsibilities; choose supported block scheduling
leaves.effects: Shared sets and locations can be reused with explicit continuity and booking constraints
leaves.recovery: Responsibility conflicts require delegation or rescheduling; available professions do not imply unlimited time

leaves.name: Delivery And Continuation
leaves.loop: Deliver episodes; finish season; receive commissioning, renewal or cancellation decisions
leaves.effects: Returning cast, assets, unresolved stories and agreements feed the next season
leaves.recovery: Cancellation settles existing work; renewal never silently resets contracts or creates funding

leaves.name: Estimate And Assumptions
leaves.loop: Break down development, cast, crew, production, facilities, post and delivery; inspect contingency
leaves.effects: Approved scope creates estimate and an explicit financing target, not cash
leaves.recovery: Unknown prices or unavailable candidates must not be estimated as free; expose uncertain lines

leaves.name: Funding Applications
leaves.loop: Choose eligible backer; prepare documents; send; await decision
leaves.effects: Calendar deadlines and submitted snapshots connect to funding pipeline
leaves.recovery: Refusal offers understandable next options without guaranteed acceptance

leaves.name: Offers And Terms
leaves.loop: Review amount, payment timing, obligations, supported rights and revenue terms; negotiate where supported; accept or reject
leaves.effects: Accepted deals create receivables and obligations; received payments increase available funds
leaves.recovery: Expired or incompatible offers cannot be accepted; cancellation preserves liabilities

leaves.name: Ledger And Payments
leaves.loop: Track promised, received, reserved, committed, spent and distributable amounts
leaves.effects: Hiring, bookings, production and revenue share one ledger
leaves.recovery: Finite nonnegative money; no duplicate settlement; failed action must not partially charge

leaves.name: Shortfalls And Closure
leaves.loop: Compare scope reductions, postponement and additional funding; settle final obligations
leaves.effects: Creative revisions change remaining cost; revenues follow agreed repayment order
leaves.recovery: No unexplained bailout; show exact shortage and recovery; do not introduce personal tax or banking systems

leaves.name: Role Brief And Search
leaves.loop: Create brief from character and dates; filter candidates; inspect availability and rates
leaves.effects: Search reflects performance method, language requirements and actual work
leaves.recovery: Unavailable candidate is not a zero-cost placeholder; identify booking conflicts

leaves.name: Auditions And Callbacks
leaves.loop: Invite; schedule; review performance evidence; shortlist; callback or chemistry read when relevant
leaves.effects: Selection gives a reasoned comparison rather than a single universal best score
leaves.recovery: Declines and missed auditions allow alternatives; background casting can use a simpler appropriate flow

leaves.name: Offers And Booking
leaves.loop: Offer terms; handle acceptance, refusal, counteroffer and expiry; reserve dates
leaves.effects: Project ledger and participant calendar update together
leaves.recovery: Cannot double-book or double-charge; cancellation and changes use explicit terms

leaves.name: Self Casting And Recasting
leaves.loop: Choose own role or no role; replace performer when necessary; review affected work
leaves.effects: Directing/acting conflicts and reshoots are visible; used former-performer work retains credit
leaves.recovery: Replacement cannot erase contributions or grant unearned work to successor

leaves.name: Billing And Award Entry
leaves.loop: Review character credits, methods, episode participation, billing and category placement
leaves.effects: Delivered versions and eligibility use the actual contributors
leaves.recovery: Story function never substitutes for size or organizer rules; prevent duplicate or missing credits

leaves.name: Department Breakdown
leaves.loop: Derive required and optional roles from project; inspect why each is needed
leaves.effects: Departments cover production tasks and readiness
leaves.recovery: Unfilled required work remains blocked and explained

leaves.name: Candidate Comparison
leaves.loop: Inspect experience relevant to task, rate, availability and existing commitments
leaves.effects: Hiring tradeoffs affect capacity and cost without inherited identity bonuses
leaves.recovery: No available candidate remains an explicit feasibility gap

leaves.name: Offers And Work Assignment
leaves.loop: Negotiate supported terms; book; assign responsibility and dates
leaves.effects: Task ownership, contracts, costs and calendars stay aligned
leaves.recovery: Declines and expiry release only appropriate reservations

leaves.name: Role Combining And Capacity
leaves.loop: Combine compatible roles at suitable scale; inspect workload and concurrency
leaves.effects: Savings come with genuine capacity limits; no free simultaneous work
leaves.recovery: Do not combine incompatible work or overwhelm one worker; split roles when scope expands

leaves.name: Replacement And History
leaves.loop: Handle absence, handover, cancellation and additional staffing
leaves.effects: Preserve work already done, credit and relationship history
leaves.recovery: Replacing a person must not reset completed tasks or avoid owed pay

leaves.name: Breakdown And Readiness
leaves.loop: Convert approved scenes to resource list; assign owners; inspect missing dependencies
leaves.effects: One readiness view links directly to unresolved work
leaves.recovery: No generic Ready label while required resources remain unavailable

leaves.name: Locations And Logistics
leaves.loop: Search, scout, compare, book, establish access and backup locations
leaves.effects: Travel, daylight, weather exposure, costs and scheduling
leaves.recovery: Location loss triggers alternatives and affected-scene review

leaves.name: Design And Builds
leaves.loop: Request concepts; approve; build or acquire props, costumes, sets and creatures; inspect
leaves.effects: Assets have versions, readiness, costs and reuse constraints
leaves.recovery: Rejected design revises affected work; lost or damaged assets require repair or replacement

leaves.name: Rehearsal And Planning
leaves.loop: Schedule table reads, blocking, stunt preparation, storyboards, shots and animatics
leaves.effects: Preparation addresses explicit production needs and discovers conflicts
leaves.recovery: Preparation has bounded effects, never infinite quality through repetition

leaves.name: Scheduling
leaves.loop: Order work by dependencies and availability; reserve resources; publish call sheets
leaves.effects: Cross-department schedules include holidays, travel, daylight and contingency
leaves.recovery: Explain conflicts; reschedule without double charging; capacity assumptions remain visible

leaves.name: Daily Readiness
leaves.loop: Check call sheet, attendance, location, equipment and scene requirements
leaves.effects: Only feasible work starts; attendance and booking history persist
leaves.recovery: Missing resources prompt switch of scene, delay or cancellation with costs

leaves.name: Scene And Setup Work
leaves.loop: Block; rehearse; light; check sound; choose coverage; record takes
leaves.effects: Each setup consumes time and produces distinct available material
leaves.recovery: No material created when required people or equipment are absent

leaves.name: Directorial Choices
leaves.loop: Review take; request adjustment; choose another take or move on
leaves.effects: Recorded choices constrain edit options and remaining daily capacity
leaves.recovery: Additional takes have costs and diminishing opportunity, not automatic perfection

leaves.name: Disruptions And Wrap
leaves.loop: Respond to weather, continuity or resource trouble; log completed and unfinished work
leaves.effects: Update money, footage, reports and next-day schedule together
leaves.recovery: A failed event rolls back consistently; partial completed work is explicitly retained

leaves.name: Pickups And Reshoots
leaves.loop: Identify missing work; estimate; book participants; schedule after prerequisites; capture
leaves.effects: New material supplements or replaces correct scenes and versions
leaves.recovery: Do not book pickups before feasible prep or primary work; preserve existing footage and credits

leaves.name: 2D Pipeline
leaves.loop: Design; storyboard; animatic; layout; animate; clean up; colour; composite
leaves.effects: Approved assets and shot dependencies determine tasks, capacity and revisions
leaves.recovery: Late animatic or design changes identify rework rather than restarting everything

leaves.name: 3D Pipeline
leaves.loop: Model; rig; layout; animate; simulate; light; render; composite
leaves.effects: Rig readiness, render capacity and asset versions govern completion
leaves.recovery: Failed or changed assets invalidate only dependent work; render expansion costs money

leaves.name: Stop Motion Pipeline
leaves.loop: Design puppets and sets; fabricate; rig; test lighting; capture frames; repair; clean up
leaves.effects: Puppet copies, stage access, continuity and animator capacity determine throughput
leaves.recovery: Damage or unavailable stages have repair/rebook paths; duplicates cost resources and enable only feasible concurrency

leaves.name: Voice And Capture
leaves.loop: Cast; book; record voice or calibrate capture; select takes; retake; clean; retarget; integrate
leaves.effects: Voice and body/face capture remain distinct work with dated sessions and used-performer credits
leaves.recovery: Insufficient studio funds block cleanly; missed sessions rebook; one performance method cannot impersonate another

leaves.name: Hybrid Integration
leaves.loop: Plan plates, tracking, practical and digital assets; approve integration; finish shots
leaves.effects: Cross-medium dependencies link filmed work to effects and final composite
leaves.recovery: Changed plates or camera work flag specific downstream tasks and revised costs

leaves.name: Research And Access
leaves.loop: Define questions; identify contributors, locations and archives; arrange access
leaves.effects: Available factual material and access shape the project
leaves.recovery: Refused access prompts editorial alternatives; do not fabricate factual verification

leaves.name: Contributors And Restrictions
leaves.loop: Invite; record agreement and use restrictions; schedule; handle withdrawal
leaves.effects: Footage use, redaction, credits and delivery respect recorded restrictions
leaves.recovery: Withdrawal before filming creates no phantom redaction work; later withdrawal shows affected material

leaves.name: Documentary Capture
leaves.loop: Plan interviews and observations; record opportunities; log coverage and factual claims
leaves.effects: Editing uses actual recorded material and research status
leaves.recovery: Missing material leads to additional interviews, archive work or a revised structure

leaves.name: Unscripted Format
leaves.loop: Define segments or competition rules; schedule participants; record progression
leaves.effects: Episode results and participant continuity persist deterministically
leaves.recovery: Format-specific rules govern outcomes; do not force every format into a scripted fiction workflow

leaves.name: Editorial Assembly
leaves.loop: Review material; verify claims; assemble; resolve restrictions; deliver
leaves.effects: Clearances and factual issues gate affected uses and deliverables
leaves.recovery: Unresolved issues remain explicit; alternatives include replacement, omission or revised delivery

leaves.name: Material Review And Assembly
leaves.loop: Inspect footage, takes, recordings and technical gaps; select; order scenes
leaves.effects: Available material constrains what can be edited
leaves.recovery: No selecting footage that was never captured; identify stale or incompatible versions

leaves.name: Structural Revision
leaves.loop: Adjust pacing and runtime; cut, restore or rearrange; review setups and payoffs
leaves.effects: Declared essential scenes and dependencies provide specific warnings
leaves.recovery: Allow intentional choices; restore or revise dependency; no penalty based merely on prose presence

leaves.name: Additional Work
leaves.loop: Request pickups, replacement voice, effects revisions or missing assets
leaves.effects: Tasks require funding, participants and schedule capacity
leaves.recovery: Explain delay and cost; preserve previously approved usable material

leaves.name: Sound And Picture Finish
leaves.loop: Edit dialogue; record ADR and Foley; add music; mix; colour; finish effects; titles and credits
leaves.effects: Dependencies and versions determine picture/sound readiness
leaves.recovery: Changing locked picture shows affected sound, captions, effects and delivery work

leaves.name: Versions And Delivery
leaves.loop: Create festival, distribution and broadcast cuts; captions, subtitles and required materials; review; lock; submit
leaves.effects: Each version has runtime, credits, content and eligibility history
leaves.recovery: Failed delivery identifies corrections; reopening a lock creates revision work rather than silently overwriting accepted files

leaves.name: Release Strategy
leaves.loop: Choose supported territories, languages, methods and windows; compare commitments
leaves.effects: Premiere eligibility, localization, audience access and deals interact
leaves.recovery: Conflicts and exclusivity appear before acceptance

leaves.name: Offers And Delivery
leaves.loop: Inspect supported terms and requirements; accept or refuse; supply correct version; receive acceptance
leaves.effects: Contracts create schedule, delivery and payment obligations
leaves.recovery: Missed materials and rejected deliveries have correction paths

leaves.name: Content And Versions
leaves.loop: Declare content; inspect outlet-specific modeled conditions; choose supported alternate edit
leaves.effects: A restriction affects the relevant outlet or territory, not all TV globally
leaves.recovery: No universal mature-content ban; clearly separate simulation assumptions from classification authority

leaves.name: Audience And Revenue
leaves.loop: Release; observe exposure, audience fit, reception and accounting
leaves.effects: Reported earnings, received funds and contractual shares remain distinct
leaves.recovery: No guarantee of success; no duplicate revenue when events replay

leaves.name: Later Windows
leaves.loop: Consider new territories, licensing or later releases; preserve release history
leaves.effects: Earlier releases constrain later deals and festival entry
leaves.recovery: Cancelled releases must not count as completed showings; agreement changes preserve obligations

leaves.name: Edition Calendar
leaves.loop: Track institution, edition, submissions, deadlines, nominations, screenings and ceremony
leaves.effects: Each year has its own data and status; scheduled events connect to attendance
leaves.recovery: Future unknown dates remain projections, not invented confirmed dates; same date in two years is allowed if correct

leaves.name: Eligibility And Categories
leaves.loop: Evaluate format, runtime, territory, release history, premiere status, credits and edition-specific rules
leaves.effects: Explain eligible and ineligible categories with evidence
leaves.recovery: Simulated rules stay labeled; official facts override generic assumptions for that edition

leaves.name: Submission
leaves.loop: Choose version and category; attach materials; review fee; submit snapshot
leaves.effects: Ledger, deadline, eligibility and entry status update together
leaves.recovery: Withdraw and resubmit with unique entries and correct charges; prevent duplicate accidental submissions

leaves.name: Selection And Attendance
leaves.loop: Receive result; accept invitation; resolve travel and conflicts; attend screening or ceremony
leaves.effects: Calendar, expenses, exposure and relationship history connect
leaves.recovery: Declining or missing events has proportionate consequences; award outcomes are not guaranteed

leaves.name: Results And History
leaves.loop: Record nomination, win, rejection or disqualification; propagate correct credits
leaves.effects: Filmography and relevant future opportunities reflect actual results
leaves.recovery: No invented verified rulebooks; organizer changes apply to correct editions without rewriting past outcomes

leaves.name: Credits And Filmography
leaves.loop: Review projects, versions, episodes, roles and collaborators
leaves.effects: Persistent portfolio supports future pitches and opportunities
leaves.recovery: Only earned contributions receive credit; historical records remain stable

leaves.name: Professional Relationships
leaves.loop: Record specific collaboration, fulfilled promises and relevant disputes
leaves.effects: Future availability and willingness may reflect relevant history
leaves.recovery: No arbitrary global relationship penalty from unrelated decisions

leaves.name: Opportunities
leaves.loop: Receive a proposal tied to prior work; inspect terms; accept or decline
leaves.effects: New work inherits actual resource and scheduling constraints
leaves.recovery: Explain why opportunity appeared; avoid guaranteed endless offers

leaves.name: Sequels And Returning Seasons
leaves.loop: Reuse explicit story continuity and eligible assets; negotiate returning participants
leaves.effects: Reuse can save work but requires availability, permissions and version compatibility
leaves.recovery: Do not carry over expired agreements or assume returning cast is free

leaves.name: Obligations And Portfolio
leaves.loop: Manage concurrent projects, remaining repayments and delivery duties
leaves.effects: One person's time and shared resources are finite across projects
leaves.recovery: New project cannot erase old debts or commitments; cancel or delegate explicitly

leaves.name: Navigation And Voice
leaves.loop: Show current situation, meaningful choices, next action and relevant history
leaves.effects: Natural event-specific language; consistent established title-case rules
leaves.recovery: No robotic generic headings, unexplained numbers or dead-end screens; do not invent absent donor rules

leaves.name: Responsive Interface
leaves.loop: Provide equivalent controls on desktop and mobile; handle drawer, safe areas, keyboard, scrolling and focus
leaves.effects: No overlap, clipped actions, lost input or sticky-header-covered destinations
leaves.recovery: Recover focus after dialogs; reserve loading space; preserve input through rerender and navigation

leaves.name: Decisions And Feedback
leaves.loop: Preview cost, time and effects; commit once; show outcome and next options
leaves.effects: Every action links to meaningful state or a legitimate creative record
leaves.recovery: Disabled actions name why and how to resolve; no decorative unimplemented features

leaves.name: Save Export Import
leaves.loop: Persist full state; reopen; export/import; distinguish duplicate lives and newer versions
leaves.effects: Documents, IDs, RNG state, events, ledger and history survive consistently
leaves.recovery: Atomic writes, sound backups, quota handling, migrations and multi-tab ownership protect progress

leaves.name: Recovery And Accessibility
leaves.loop: Retry failed loads; recover damaged save; navigate by keyboard and assistive technology
leaves.effects: Errors preserve work and explain recovery; screen-reader labels match actions
leaves.recovery: No silent reset or fake success; physical-device and human accessibility checks remain separately recorded

leaves.name: Feature Ledger
leaves.loop: Give every leaf an ID; map UI, engine, dependencies, outcomes, tests and source status
leaves.effects: An auditable coverage matrix distinguishes planned from implemented and verified
leaves.recovery: No feature marked complete because a screen or helper exists

leaves.name: Research Ledger
leaves.loop: Record source, edition, retrieval date, applicability and verified/modelled/projected status
leaves.effects: Real rules and calibrated game assumptions stay distinguishable
leaves.recovery: Unavailable evidence triggers alternate public primary research or an honest gap, never invented certainty

leaves.name: Engine Verification
leaves.loop: Test state transitions, boundaries, failure paths, determinism and migration
leaves.effects: Money, time, identities, dependencies and history remain internally consistent
leaves.recovery: Meaningful tests fail on old defects; no tests that merely echo the implementation

leaves.name: Browser Journeys
leaves.loop: Exercise real decisions from creation through next project on desktop and mobile
leaves.effects: Screenshots, traces, state assertions and reload checks prove connected behavior
leaves.recovery: Do not conceal failure with arbitrary sleeps, forced clicks, retries or skips; label fixtures

leaves.name: Human Acceptance
leaves.loop: Play varied careers; assess clarity, agency, pacing and variety; inspect real devices
leaves.effects: Feedback informs tuning without claiming automated tests measure enjoyment
leaves.recovery: Record remaining limitations; no assertion of perfection or universal coverage from finite samples
